_comment: Personal server, registered at USER scope so it follows you across every
project instead of being committed here. Do not copy this file into
.mcp.json - that would make a personal tool everyone's problem.
claude mcp add --scope user scratchpad -- uv run python personal_scratchpad.py
Then confirm both scopes are live in one session with /mcp, which lists
the project-scoped issue-tracker and the user-scoped scratchpad together.
